harmless: Woke up with the usual dull ache low down on the left. Took two ibuprofen with breakfast and it eased by ten. Work was fine, a bit tired after lunch. Drank lots of water, had a warm bath in the evening. Mood okay, slept about seven hours.

Day 2 of my period. Flow medium, changed pad every four or five hours. Cramps around 5/10 in the morning, heat pad helped. Felt a bit lightheaded standing up fast but it passed straight away and I ate a snack. Evening walk with my sister.

Bloated all afternoon, jeans felt tight. Skipped the gym. Had a salad and tea. Mild back ache on the right side after sitting at my desk for hours, stretched and it went. No fever, nothing else. Booked my GP appointment for next week about the cycle length.

Spotting for two days before the period was due, brown, light. Slight twinge on one side around ovulation last week but it only lasted an hour. Using the app to track. Feeling hopeful because the blood tests are booked and I wrote my questions down.

Bad pain night. Woke at 2am with cramps about 7 out of 10 which is normal for me on day one. Took ibuprofen and codeine as the GP advised, used the hot water bottle, back to sleep by 3. Slept in a bit. Not sick, not dizzy, eating fine.

Acne flare on my chin and jaw again, hair seems to be shedding in the shower. Annoyed but coping. Spoke to a friend about it and felt better. Started the spearmint tea thing, will see. Weight about the same. Energy low mid-afternoon.

Ate out with the family, loads of food, felt full and bloated and a bit sick after the cake, passed by evening. Thirsty because of the salty food, drank water. Periods due in a few days so expecting the usual cramps and mood dip.

New medication from the GP, started metformin today. Mild nausea after dinner, took it with food like the leaflet says. Tired. Will note any side effects for the follow-up. No rash, no swelling, just a slightly upset tummy.

Pelvic pain during sex again, dull and deep, about 4 out of 10, stopped and it settled. Mentioned to my partner. I want to raise it at the appointment. No bleeding. Felt a bit low afterwards but talked it through and it was fine.

Heavy day, changed pad about every three hours, a few small clots like usual. Took iron tablets. Slight headache from screens, drank water. Felt tired but not faint. Plan to ask the doctor about iron levels.

Walked 8,000 steps, cramps came on mid-afternoon, 5 out of 10, took paracetamol and it was gone in an hour. Mood fine. Appointment letter arrived for the gynae clinic in December, put it in the calendar.
Shoulder ache from the gym, not related. Period pain mild, 3/10. Wee normal. Bowels slightly loose as always on day one. Ate normally, slept well. Looking forward to the weekend.

Fertility check-in: we are trying for a baby, day 21, took a test early out of nerves and it was negative, bit sad but okay. Bloating and sore breasts, usual before a period. No bleeding yet. Taking folic acid daily.
Started the new pill three weeks ago. Spotting has settled, mood a bit flat but improving, breasts less tender. Remembered every dose. Will review with the nurse at the three month check.
Constipated and crampy, ibuprofen helped. Drank prune juice, loo this evening, relief. Back pain mild. Temperature normal. Worried a bit about the endo scan result next week but keeping busy.
Stress at work, tension headache across the forehead, paracetamol and a dark room helped. Neck stiff from the laptop, not a fever. Slept badly. Period due soon, expecting cramps.
Sharp twinge in the right side when I stood up from the sofa, lasted a few seconds, then nothing. Ovulation day I think. No sickness, no bleeding, no dizziness, just noting it for the doctor.
Anaemia follow-up blood test done at the clinic, felt a bit faint when they took the blood but sat down with juice and was fine within minutes. Tired afterwards, napped. Will get results next week.
Period finished. Light day, just spotting at the end. Energy coming back. Went for a swim, no pain. Reflected that tracking helps me explain things at appointments. Feeling positive.
Hot flush type sweats at night, probably the stress, bed damp. No fever, felt fine in the morning. Breasts sore, cycle day 26. Planning to mention night sweats to the GP.
